snap_point.limits: CUDA grid and <=4096 nearest vertices; CPU native CAD nearest point on edge/trimmed face. Capture radius can reject. Native ties return first solution.

merge_mesh.limits: CPU concatenate indexed objects; optional first-representative weld. Internal faces remain; solid union uses boolean_union, surface merge uses sew_surfaces.

move_along_curve.limits: CUDA bounded analytic/B-spline curve records; numerical Gauss arc length and inverse solve; open-domain clamp or reject, unit tangent frame. No periodic wrapping.

move_on_mesh.limits: CUDA straightest face walk with edge parallel transport; <=128 vertices,256 triangles/crossings. Ambiguous vertex hits, nonmanifold crossings and degenerate faces reject; open boundary clamps with status=2.

move_on_surface.limits: CUDA NURBS UV displacement returns attached point, path tangent and normal; finite domain, regular surface and nonzero displacement. UV trajectory is not a world-space geodesic.
